medium

Connection Analyzer does not use a documented ARM base resource type

Gap: The resource-type guidance says an ARM resource is modeled by choosing a base type, but ConnectionAnalyzer is a plain model marked with Legacy.customAzureResource.

Expected

A resource-shaped child chooses a documented ARM base and declares its parent instead of reconstructing the envelope in a legacy plain model.

Guidance: ARM resource types and modeling — Resource types and child resources

Documented child resource model
@parentResource(Employee)
model Job is ProxyResource<JobProperties> {
  ...ResourceNameParameter<Job>;
}
Actual

ConnectionAnalyzer is a plain model with Legacy.customAzureResource and manually repeated ARM envelope fields.

CRUDL uses ArmResourceRead, ArmResourceCreateOrReplace, ArmTagsPatch or ArmCustomPatch, ArmResourceDelete, and ArmResourceListByParent; actions are reserved for behavior outside CRUDL.

ConnectionAnalyzer PUT, GET, PATCH, and DELETE use Legacy.RoutedOperations action helpers, while list is manually routed.
